# Face fixture with a held video tail

Credit: NASA. Image source, public-domain status, crop, and original hash are
recorded in [the portrait provenance](face-source.png.source.md).
This is a test-only transformation and does not imply NASA endorsement.

Generated by [the fixture generator](../../../scripts/make-face-detector-motion-fixture.mjs).
The first 18 frames of `face-motion.mp4` are copied without re-encoding; the last
video frame starts at `17/30` seconds and ends at `0.6` seconds. Generated silent
audio extends the file to `0.7` seconds. Export displays the final measured face
frame during this extra time. The corresponding face box is the last visible
box in `face-motion.json`.

Contains no private footage or audio. Generated 2026-10-14; camera model and
firmware are not applicable.
